name: CommonEval
intro: CommonEval 是 VoiceBench 的 200 条真人语音开放式问答子集。研究者从 Mozilla Common Voice 的多样说话人和个人设备录音中人工收集信息寻求类问题，并在标准文本与原始语音两种输入设置下让语音助手回答，再用 GPT-4o-mini 按 1–5 分评估文本回答内容。
org: Yiming Chen, Xianghu Yue, Chen Zhang, Xiaoxue Gao, Robby T. Tan, Haizhou Li; National University of Singapore
build_method: 从Mozilla Common Voice真人录音中人工收集信息寻求类问题
eval_feature: 真人录音, 文本/语音配对设置, 只评回答内容
build_method_en: Manual collection of information-seeking questions from human Mozilla Common Voice recordings
eval_feature_en: Human recordings, paired text/speech settings, response-content scoring only
intro_en: CommonEval is the 200-item real-speech open-ended QA subset of VoiceBench. Researchers manually collect information-seeking questions from Mozilla Common Voice recordings made by diverse speakers on personal devices, evaluate voice assistants with both ground-truth text and original speech inputs, and use GPT-4o-mini to score text-response content from 1 to 5.
scale_en: 200 items; average 8.06 words and 4.83 seconds of audio
drawio_review_note: Aligned with VoiceBench arXiv:2410.17196 Sections 3.1–3.2 and the official VoiceBench repository. CommonEval is a VoiceBench subset rather than a generic bilingual text benchmark. The authors manually collect information-seeking questions from Mozilla Common Voice, whose speech is recorded by diverse speakers on personal devices in realistic conditions. The released subset contains 200 human-recorded English open-ended QA items, averaging 8.06 words and 4.83 seconds of audio. VoiceBench evaluates both ground-truth text instructions and original speech instructions, asks the assistant to generate a response, and evaluates text-response content rather than speech-output or transcription quality. GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18 assigns a 1–5 response-quality score against the ground-truth instruction. The official repository runs the commoneval test split in audio or text modality, applies api_judge.py, and aggregates with the open evaluator.
